# Shop architecture

## Reporting

Could you add a process. Everything here runs on Kubernetes. I want you to put the process on the right side. Also, please never drag the process to the right.

I want you to enlarge the process. After that, i need you to turn it green, but now insert a dashed service in the center. Also, please make the process huge. Also, now bring the process to front.

I need you to label the process auth. Then okay so sketch an end.

Now shift the end a quarter of the way to the top edge, and sketch a client named nginx and then now delete the process. Then shift the client a third of the way to the top edge and okay so add a pink step in the top left.

Lets add 3 hexagons. Please never wrap these hexagons.

Okay so connect the client and the service with an arrow. Measure the latency of the payment path. Lets push the client to the right edge.

Align all hexagons vertically please. Link the client to the end with an orange connector and then could you insert a decision.

## Data layer

Can you join the star to the step. Before that, add a star in the lower right please. After that, can you attach the service to the star.

Lets make the step thick. A cloud hovers above the server, suggesting remote storage. I need you to resize the step to medium.

Now add a huge textbox called partner. Print this diagram on a large poster. Okay so change the color of the textbox to teal.

Please link every hexagon to the next one and then please make the step bigger. Would you draw a file next to the step, but can you add four services.

Please move the file a quarter of the way to the bottom edge, and i want you to make the file large and i need you to slide the teal textbox to the left.

Distribute all hexagons evenly horizontally, but do not make the pink step tiny. After that, now copy the step at the top, but push the star halfway to the left edge please, but i need you to duplicate the star.

## Storage

Draw a large box and could you set the color of the decision to teal. Then can you place the decision 120 pixels right of the client. Now connect every hexagon to the next one.

Would you send the end to back. Calculate the monthly cost of the servers. Okay so make the end large.

Would you add a thin actor named signup next to the textbox. Also, i need you to organize all services from the second section in a circle.

I need you to make the end green, but would you connect the end and the file with a large line and then make the end bigger please, and i need you to align the services from section 2 to the left. Could you group these services from the second section into a container called shipping.

Could you make the teal decision solid. Then now sketch 4 databases. After that, i need you to slide the end on the right side. After that, i need you to rename it epsilon. Then can you add a gray rectangle.

## Order flow

Would you sketch a black store called postgres in the top left and then could you grow postgres.

Lets shift the store 150 pixels right of the rectangle. Nobody remembers why the queue exists. I want you to name the store sessions.

Okay so draw a large actor labelled approval. After that, lets link the services from the second section in a chain. Then would you make signup 100 percent bigger. Could you change the color of signup to yellow.

Make the decision thin please. After that, could you make the thin decision large.

I need you to make the teal decision small. After that, make the service from the first section 200 percent smaller and then now scale the first service to tiny, but would you organize the hexagons as a flow from left to right.

Delete every hexagon please. Can you change the color of the decision to yellow, but rename the start to settings please. Before that, sketch a dotted start on the right side please, and please sketch 6 teal diamonds.

Okay so grow settings. Nobody remembers why the queue exists. Now arrange all services from the second section as a flow from left to right. Can you arrange all databases as a flow from top to bottom.

## Analytics

Okay so draw an ellipse above the first service and then could you drag the ellipse halfway to the bottom edge and i want you to change the color of the rectangle to orange, but would you put the rectangle on the right side. Then could you make it 25 percent bigger.

Please add two stores. Print this diagram on a large poster. Lets inside the service from section 1 , add a solid file, and could you put a brown hexagon next to the second file.

Lets paint the hexagon white. Would you insert two red servers and then could you link all stores from section 5 in a chain.

Make the start large, but now send approval to back, but can you insert a black diamond called alpha next to the actor from the fourth section. Okay so scale the dashed service from the first section to small.

I need you to wrap all services from the second section. Also, could you call the yellow decision from the first section scheduler.

Could you align the databases vertically. Animate the arrows with a gentle glow. I want you to group these databases into a container called profile.

## Billing

Could you on the right side , draw a dotted note, but okay so below the note from section 6 , draw a black gateway. Write a summary of the design for the board. Lets group all servers from the fifth section, but now draw a queue.

I need you to change the color of the queue to purple and could you place the queue on the right side. Then rename the purple queue to mailer. I want you to resize mailer to large. I need you to wrap the stores from the fifth section.

Could you wrap the stores from the fifth section, but bring the file from section 2 to front please. The marketing team prefers softer colours. Could you link the file from section 2 to alpha. Could you arrange the stores from the fifth section in a circle.

Now link all services from the second section one after the other. After that, i want you to attach the first store to the queue.

I need you to put a solid actor at the top. I need you to attach the servers from the fifth section in a chain and i want you to attach each server from the fifth section to the next. Also, could you make the rectangle 25 % smaller.

## Messaging

Please above the rectangle , insert an orange triangle, and could you rename partner to draft. Lets on the right side , draw a title.

Okay so above the title , create a report and then please shift it inside the note from section 6. Can you scale the report to huge. Then drag the second dotted note halfway to the top edge. Also, i want you to put a blue cache above the note from the sixth section.

Could you organize the stores from the fifth section in a grid. Our cat walked across the keyboard here. Make the diamond from the fifth section thick.

I want you to make the third diamond 120 percent smaller. Then would you push alpha to the top edge.

Never make the diamond from the fifth section tiny, and would you put the third solid actor on the right side.

Okay so resize the actor from the sixth section to tiny. Lets attach the solid actor from the sixth section to approval.

Now align the stores from the fifth section horizontally. Would you join the third actor to the orange triangle and then connect the databases in a chain please. Also, okay so join the start to the actor from section 3 with a white line, but i need you to connect the start and the client with a black connector.

## Back office

Please on the right side , insert a queue, and i want you to connect the queue from section 8 and the report with an arrow, and would you change the color of the queue from the eighth section to red and then organize the diamonds from section 4 in a grid please. Then i want you to resize the black store from the fourth section to huge.

Could you arrange the servers from the fifth section as a flow from left to right. Then i want you to connect the decision from the first section and the ellipse with a teal arrow. Copy the report 25 px below scheduler please.

Can you shrink the cache. This part was designed in a hurry. Make the queue from section 8 120 % smaller please.

Please change the color of the second queue to orange and then i want you to make the queue from the eighth section 50 percent bigger and then now shrink the queue from section 8.

Can you make the first decision dotted. Then left of the third actor , create a note please. Also, lets align the diamonds from section 4 vertically. Animate the arrows with a gentle glow. Make the note from section 6 30 % smaller.

## User accounts

I want you to create a red document, and i want you to join the third red document to the first decision with a large arrow.

Drag the rectangle 50 px down please. Then i want you to turn the client red. Then now create a red circle. Our cat walked across the keyboard here. Okay so make it huge.

Can you connect the title and the note from the sixth section with a connector and can you make the decision from the first section thick and i want you to delete the third document. Would you make nginx 75 percent smaller. Okay so never link the red servers from section 5 in a chain.

Okay so dont make the client 80 % bigger. Could you connect each database to the next. Lets make scheduler thin and would you sketch a dotted gateway called payments next to the decision from the first section.

I need you to put an ellipse in the top right, but okay so resize scheduler to large.

Now below scheduler , insert a client, and i want you to resize the second queue to medium.

## Monitoring

Please remove the second queue. After that, make the title tiny please, and lets create a cloud called accounts on the right side, but please space all the services from the second section 20 px apart and i want you to join the note from the eighth section to the purple queue.

Change the color of the triangle to black. I need you to space the diamonds from section 4 60 px apart. Could you slide draft 200 px below the gateway from the ninth section. Also, please add a tiny cache labelled maria, but lets group the stores from the fifth section.

Do not group these databases please. Our auditors asked for this view last year. Now group all servers from the fifth section as pricing. Now put the store from the fourth section right of the actor from section 4. Then i want you to connect sessions to the third actor.

Make the first file bigger. Then would you put the file from the second section inside the cache from the tenth section.

Clone the file from the second section right of the gateway from the sixth section. Okay so rename the second gateway to login, and could you insert 3 thick triangles. Also, i need you to rename the start to delta. Can you move delta to the bottom edge.

## Search

I need you to create 5 black databases. Then would you make scheduler dotted. I want you to drag it inside the second ellipse and i need you to join the textbox from section 2 to the hexagon with an arrow, and i want you to rename draft to settings.

Rename the green end to peter please, but join the start to the diamond from the fifth section please. Bring the start to front.

Make the first service 60 percent smaller, and i need you to connect maria to the rectangle with a line.

Can you in the lower left , add a large client, but lets make the first dashed service small.

Please enlarge the first service, but i want you to insert a green star and okay so draw a gateway.

Please join the gateway from section 11 to mailer. Also, would you call the second actor pending. Our auditors asked for this view last year. Now create an end labelled omega.

Okay so scale the second end to medium. Show the traffic in real time. Change the color of the end from section 11 to gray.

## Payment services

Okay so draw a database. Now attach all the black databases from the eleventh section one after the other. Lets put a caption next to the dotted start.

I want you to bring the caption to front, and would you make the caption 15 % bigger. I need you to connect the ellipse from the ninth section to the caption, but lets copy the title below the first store and then please align the thick triangles from the tenth section horizontally.

Now move the second client next to the first decision. A cloud hovers above the server, suggesting remote storage. Could you make the actor from the fourth section large.

Lets place pending 200 px left of the actor from section 3, but shrink the second actor please. Then now right of the second note , insert a report.

Now drag the dashed service from section 1 halfway to the left edge. Would you duplicate the service from section 1. Now push mailer to the left edge.

I want you to push the queue on the right side. Also, lets make the decision from section 1 dotted and then would you push delta 75 px right of the circle.

## Integrations

Can you inside the dotted start , sketch a purple rectangle. Also, now sketch a thick ellipse called gamma and move the third ellipse to the bottom edge. Make the database feel more trustworthy. I need you to connect the gateway from section 6 and the third ellipse with a connector.

Please rename the first gateway to invoices and make the decision from the first section solid.

Create a store named beta please, and can you scale the third store to tiny, and set the color of beta to pink please. Please drag the database from the twelfth section to the right edge. After that, i need you to drag the third database five px above the first cache.

Now place the database from the twelfth section 15 px below the circle. Then okay so rename the database from section 12 to sara. Then can you paint sara yellow, but lets resize the cloud to medium. After that, could you link the diamonds from the fourth section in a chain.

I need you to join the actor from the sixth section to the client from section 9 with a line. Could you make the start pink. Then i need you to slide the circle 10 px above the start. After that, would you make the first decision solid.

## Notifications

I need you to draw a cloud 30 px above the first decision. Lets insert a queue. After that, please make scheduler solid. Also, please connect mailer and scheduler with a yellow arrow and then i want you to name the textbox from the second section mark.

Can you link the teal textbox from the second section to the second ellipse. Okay so align all the thick triangles from the tenth section down. After that, could you join the diamonds from the fourth section in a chain.

I want you to send signup to back. Lets connect the client from section 11 to signup with a connector and could you move the third client up, but please draw a purple triangle 150 px right of the caption and then lets wrap these triangles from section 10.

Please dont group the stores from the fifth section as ledger. Can you change the color of the caption to pink.

Connect the caption and the note from the sixth section with a brown connector and then inside the caption , sketch a blue square. Never drag the blue square to the bottom edge please. Would you shift the first textbox left of sara.

## Shipping

If you above the first textbox , sketch a small rectangle, could you drag the third rectangle to the right. After that, would you place a square at the bottom. Label the second square redis please. After that, okay so in the lower left , sketch a circle.

I want you to create 6 titles and then could you rename omega to search. I want you to make the second gateway five % smaller. Also, please turn it blue. Rotate the whole picture slightly. I want you to scale the second blue gateway to tiny.

Could you bring login to front and i want you to paint the third ellipse yellow.

Would you slide gamma to the top edge. Write a summary of the design for the board. Shrink the ellipse from the thirteenth section please.

Could you align the thick triangles from section 10 vertically. Could you link the cache from section 10 to invoices with a connector. Could you sketch a thick start, and now align all databases from the third section to the right.

## Front end

I need you to add a start. Print this diagram on a large poster. Please group all triangles from the tenth section as archive.

I want you to shift the second cloud a quarter of the way to the bottom edge. Then can you group all the teal diamonds from the fourth section into a container called metrics. A cloud hovers above the server, suggesting remote storage. I need you to drag the queue from the fourteenth section a quarter of the way to the right edge, but can you delete the databases from the eleventh section.

I want you to scale the square from the fifteenth section to tiny. I need you to connect the second square and scheduler with a dotted connector.

Make the first yellow decision thick please. The cache was added after the outage. Would you shift sessions to the right and please make the store from section 4 smaller.

Make the first black store 20 % smaller, and would you align all the databases from section 3 horizontally. Also, i need you to call the second square worker, but can you draw a hexagon left of the purple rectangle from the thirteenth section. Also, organize the stores from the fifth section as a flow from left to right.

## Review

Erase all stores from the fifth section please, and now connect the cache from the tenth section to the second end. Then can you connect the first decision and the circle from section 15 with a line, but would you add two red caches. Users love how fast the checkout feels. Now remove every teal diamond from the fourth section.

I want you to connect the queue from the fourteenth section and accounts with a dashed arrow. After that, erase it. Highlight the risky parts in some way. Please remove the third start. Also, make maria tiny please.

Organize the databases from the third section in a grid please. After that, drag the first green end halfway to the bottom edge please. After that, would you arrange the databases from the third section as a flow from top to bottom.

Can you scale accounts to tiny, but can you shift the cloud from the tenth section a third of the way to the right edge. I want you to connect the second store and accounts with a line, but could you join each cache from the seventeenth section to the next.

# Support desk

## Search

Create a caption called sessions. Also, i want you to shrink the caption. Would you in the top left , sketch a box.

Would you drag the box to the right. After that, okay so rename the box to mark. After that, paint mark purple please.

Please never name the box anna. Also, lets make the caption blue. After that, i need you to connect the caption to the box with a large arrow. Then join sessions to the purple box.

Now put the box right of the caption, and would you set the color of sessions to green. Then would you tidy everything as a flow from top to bottom.

Okay so connect the box and the green caption with an arrow, and i need you to add 5 tiny titles. I want you to rename the caption to worker. A cloud hovers above the server, suggesting remote storage. I need you to connect the caption and mark with a connector.

Now connect worker and mark with a brown connector, but lets wrap these titles. Copy mark, but please bring worker to front.

## Billing

I want you to create a solid service named backend next to the caption. Imagine a river of data flowing through the system. Could you shift the service above the green caption. Also, i need you to sketch four reports.

Join the reports one after the other please. After that, would you place a teal star right of the caption.

Would you bring the solid service to front, and now insert 3 starts.

Shift the solid service halfway to the bottom edge please and now organize all reports as a flow from left to right. After that, please sketch 2 thin diamonds. Highlight the risky parts in some way. Lets call the caption reports_db.

Okay so put a store inside reports_db, but rename the store to paul please and then dont make it brown.

I want you to make backend 40 percent bigger, but now insert a comment.

Would you align all reports to the right. Send the star to back please. Link the comment to the star with a purple arrow please.

Distribute all the starts evenly vertically please, and okay so change the color of backend to blue. Could you organize everything as a tree. Could you scale the star to small and then make it smaller.

## Front end

I need you to align the diamonds to the right. Could you make reports_db bigger. Can you insert a huge file right of the caption. Then now make it teal. Sprinkle some icons around the edges. I need you to distribute the diamonds evenly vertically.

Please connect backend to the star with a line. Nobody remembers why the queue exists. Would you make the service twenty % smaller.

Please slide the comment left of the file. Also, would you shrink the comment. Also, can you insert a blue api at the top, and now insert a decision called postgres.

Would you make postgres thick. Ask the architect whether this is correct. Do not make the decision from the third section 50 percent bigger please. Also, okay so below the second decision , draw a thin process. Make it 40 % smaller please.

Now dont make reports_db 100 percent smaller. Then could you add a thin star inside the caption. I want you to group these diamonds from the second section.

Could you align all reports vertically. This part was designed in a hurry. Please send the api from section 3 to back, but can you drag the store to the left edge.

## Security

Draw a client named anna inside paul. Show the traffic in real time. Please delete all the diamonds from the second section.

Now make the star from section 3 60 percent smaller, and would you attach the first star to the second star with a connector and then could you organize all the titles in a column. Now change the color of the api from the third section to gray, but join each start to the next one.

Now connect the second api and the caption with a line. After that, duplicate the api from the third section. I want you to call the store delta.

I need you to slide the decision 80 pixels right and then okay so rename reports_db to payments. The marketing team prefers softer colours. Would you align all starts to the right. Would you drag the thick decision 25 px down.

I want you to organize the titles in a column and would you copy the second star in the lower right. Now wrap all titles. Also, turn the comment pink.

## Order flow

Lets add a dashed file called orders on the left side and then can you make it large. Would you connect each start to the next one.

Lets connect the client and the file from the fifth section with an arrow and rename anna to archive please. After that, could you delete it. Then lets create a report called done next to backend. Also, could you bring done to front.

Can you slide the file from the third section 80 pixels up, and could you sketch a thick gateway called ledger inside orders.

Would you move the decision to the right. I need you to add a title, and please slide the second title on the left side and then grow the caption.

I want you to copy the caption right of the second title, but now turn it teal. I need you to place the report from the fifth section in the top left and then please rename the file from section 5 to sessions.

Would you slide done 80 pixels right. After that, now send done to back and then can you send the first file to back. Would you set the color of the file from the third section to red.

## Messaging

Okay so insert two blue ellipses, and could you change the color of ledger to gray.

Lets above ledger , draw a title, and okay so change the color of the third title to purple. I want you to space all reports from section 2 twenty px apart.

## Security

Would you insert a medium square labelled checkout. Please sketch a dashed cloud. Could you make the cloud large. Lets grow the cloud. Also, please bring the cloud to front.

Please rename the yellow step to kafka. Now connect the step and the square with a dashed arrow. I need you to duplicate kafka 75 px right of checkout. Then would you put a red report below checkout.

Dont make checkout small please. Would you insert a black service called login in the lower left. I want you to insert an end and then i need you to delete this end.

Would you resize checkout to medium and then i want you to make the report tiny. Please duplicate the square.

I need you to delete the service. Print this diagram on a large poster. Could you place a server above the report. After that, i need you to insert a cloud called metrics above the server and now put a decision on the right side and then on the right side , create a thin store please.

## Data layer

I need you to make the store smaller. Also, would you connect metrics to the store.

Enlarge the cloud please. Could you connect the cloud and the server with a connector. Give the user a happy face. Push the cloud 25 pixels down please. Lets rename it refunds.

Shrink the store, but can you create an end 200 pixels below the store, but would you drag the thin store to the left edge and then please bring the store to front. Play a sound whenever a box appears. Would you connect the store to the server with a huge line.

Would you put an user on the right side. After that, okay so turn the decision gray. Also, okay so dont join the end to the decision with a line and then i want you to add a square in the lower right.

Now push the end halfway to the bottom edge. Could you make the end small and would you add a circle named pending left of the gray decision. Okay so arrange everything as a flow from top to bottom. Now attach the store to the server with an arrow.

## Storage

Okay so create a small document called postgres. Then i need you to move the document a third of the way to the bottom edge.

Remove the user please. After that, could you call the store anna. Please insert a hexagon named accounts and then connect the hexagon to the cloud.

Make the hexagon bigger. Ask the architect whether this is correct. I need you to move postgres to the right edge and could you connect the document to the thin store. I want you to make the decision dotted.

Sketch 3 medium ellipses. Then now insert a white service inside the end and then please create a dashed step left of the second service. Write a summary of the design for the board. Do not duplicate the hexagon on the left side.

Okay so do not make the decision solid. After that, okay so dont change the color of the service from section 3 to yellow and okay so join the service from the third section to the circle with a dashed connector. Also, can you join the second service to the server from the first section with an arrow.

## Messaging

I want you to add three actors. Would you group the actors into a container called nginx.

Okay so make the cloud 75 percent bigger. Arrange all the actors as a flow from left to right. Also, please send the dotted decision to back. Also, arrange the actors as a flow from left to right. Then i need you to delete all actors.

Can you label the decision search and then put a report next to search. Could you insert 4 services. Our cat walked across the keyboard here. Slide the document to the bottom edge.

Now turn postgres purple and would you connect postgres and the cloud with a gray arrow. Also, enlarge the cloud, and add 5 stores please. Also, okay so put anna right of postgres.

Please erase the first store. Print this diagram on a large poster. Would you space the services from the fourth section 5 px apart.

Join the second service to the first server with a thick connector please. Also, i need you to copy search next to the end.

## Back office

I want you to sketch a small actor. Please place the actor inside accounts. Now make the report from section 1 smaller. Then okay so rename the report from section 1 to worker.

I need you to turn worker yellow. Our auditors asked for this view last year. Lets group these ellipses into a container called auth.

Would you group all the stores as cart, but i want you to insert a huge decision called epsilon above pending. Also, now add a circle on the right side. After that, i want you to push the circle from section 5 to the left edge.

Can you sketch six hexagons. Also, now erase that circle from the fifth section.

Now move the hexagon from the third section 60 px above epsilon. Then now create four brown clouds and i need you to push the cloud from section 1 up. Then lets put a blue cache inside the report from the first section.

Lets group these hexagons from section 5 and insert a circle. Also, please place the report from the fourth section in the center. Also, okay so organize everything in a grid.

## Order flow

Lets above worker , add a database. Okay so tidy everything in a column. I want you to drag the report from section 4 to the bottom edge. Can you shift the first server 100 pixels up.

Now slide the first cloud below worker, but now link the document to the first hexagon.

Can you connect the document to refunds. Then could you enlarge epsilon. Translate every label into French. I want you to turn the actor blue and then i need you to group these stores. Could you put a dashed circle in the lower left.

Now do not join the third circle to the first server with a connector. After that, i need you to join each store to the next one. I want you to make the cache 150 % bigger.

Lets put epsilon in the center. Also, lets delete every service from the fourth section, but could you set the color of pending to orange.

Could you make pending fifty percent smaller. The marketing team prefers softer colours. Now place a pink start above the end.

Please connect the cloud from the first section to the start with a gray line and i want you to push the cache a third of the way to the right edge.

Would you align the hexagons from the fifth section vertically. Put a triangle inside worker please. Then can you draw two ends. Everything here runs on Kubernetes. Can you clone the triangle and lets above refunds , draw a tiny title.

Can you connect all ellipses one after the other. The cache was added after the outage. Remove all ends from section 7 please.

I need you to create a star in the lower left. It should look friendly to new customers. Sketch an api please, but lets place the api from section 7 next to the second report. Attach each store to the next please.

Okay so join the second report to the database with a large connector. I need you to make the report from the fourth section tiny.

I want you to space all the ellipses 10 px apart and please scale the third circle to huge. Nobody remembers why the queue exists. Add an actor please.
